title: Rank 1 cannot reach a rank-2 update
notes: Now D's first row is (−1, 2, −2, 1) and the other three are (1, 0, 0, −1): two directions. Every row of a rank-1 ΔW is a multiple of the same row, so it cannot make both. The loss falls from 16 and stops at 4.01. The best any rank-1 ΔW can do is 4.00.
